verdict.rationale: Notte documents a public REST API with an API reference section, including Bearer-token authentication and endpoints such as agent start. Its docs also say cloud sessions can be controlled programmatically, scripts can be deployed as invocable API endpoints, and sessions expose a CDP endpoint. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes of the common paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API.
